children: is expected to end its bounce in a range of $91.90 to $93.14 per barrel, as a wave C from $105.03 looks incomplete.

This wave has briefly travelled below its 123.6% projection level of $87.39. Given that it had not finished around the 100% level of $90.76, it is likely to extend into the range formed by the 161.8% and the 138.2% levels.

Support is at $90.65, a break below which may trigger a fall into the range of $88.17 to $89.11. On the daily chart, the white candle formed during the previous trading session was proportionally too small to constitute a reversal pattern when compared with the large black candle on November 4.
Although a further bounce might be likely, the downtrend may remain intact.
